reasons: Outcome is wrong: no direct OTel metric measures dropped connections, so the request should be blocked with MISSING_METRIC_MAPPING. The proposed accepted-minus-handled expression belongs in notes, not in promql.
The candidate computes accepted minus handled, which is a derived difference, not the Datadog nginx.net.conn_dropped_per_s quantity. It is a different quantity.
Datadog nginx.net.conn_dropped_per_s is already a per-second rate, while the candidate subtracts two cumulative connection-count rates. The unit and meaning differ.
The first term uses a fixed [5m] range, which violates the rule that only $__rate_interval may be used as a range.
The Datadog template variable $Host (prefix host, default *) should become a host=~"$Host" matcher, but the candidate drops it.
The Datadog metric is a per-host series, but the candidate has no host grouping or matcher, so the series set differs.
